shell.offline.title: خدمة freeRGB غير قيد التشغيل
shell.offline.text: الإضاءة تستمر في خدمة الخلفية مستقلة عن هذه النافذة. ابدأها هنا أو من مشغّل freeRGB أو من
shell.paused: الإضاءة متوقفة مؤقتًا — أجهزتك تعرض إضاءتها الخاصة. لا تتأثر المراوح.
shell.conflict_one: {names} قيد التشغيل — يترك freeRGB أجهزتك وشأنها حتى إغلاقها.
shell.conflict_other: {names} قيد التشغيل — يترك freeRGB أجهزتك وشأنها حتى إغلاقها.
palette.title: لوحة الأوامر
palette.placeholder: انتقل إلى عرض، طبّق تأثيرًا، حمّل ملفًا شخصيًا…
demo.banner: عرض متصفح · أجهزة وهمية فقط · التنزيلات والقراءات محاكاة. لا وصول للأجهزة أو الميكروفون أو الشاشة. التغييرات أُعيد تعيينها عند إعادة التحميل.
demo.failedText: جرب متصفحًا حديثًا وأعد تحميل هذه الصفحة. لا حاجة إلى اتصال أجهزة.
tour.welcome.title: مرحبًا بك في freeRGB
tour.welcome.text: تعمل الإضاءة في خدمة خلفية صغيرة. هذه النافذة هي فقط وحدة التحكم عن بُعد — أغلقها متى شئت، وتبقى الأضواء قيد التشغيل.
tour.welcome.demo: استكشف الواجهة المكتبية الحقيقية مع أجهزة وهمية. يعمل هذا العرض entirely في هذا Tab; ولا يتصل بأجهزة، وتُعاد تعيين التغييرات при إعادة التحميل.
tour.nav.title: كل شيء في مكان واحد
tour.nav.text: الإضاءة والJanuary hardware والأتمتة مجمّعة على اليسار. مفاتيح الأسهم تنتقل عبر القائمة.
tour.search.title: بحث سريع
tour.search.text: اضغط Ctrl+K في أي مكان للانتقال إلى عرض أو بدء تأثير أو تحميل ملف شخصي.
tour.now.title: ما الذي يعمل
tour.now.text: التأثير الحالي والسطوع الإجمالي لجميع الأجهزة.
tour.effects.title: اختر تأثيرًا
tour.effects.text: نقرة واحدة تبدل جميع الأجهزة. التأثيرات المحفوظة يظهر أدناه.
tour.inspector.title: ضبط دقيق
tour.inspector.text: الألوان والسرعة والمزيد للتأثير قيد التشغيل. التغييرات تُطبق live وتتذكر pelo serviço.
tour.inspector.demo: جرب الألوان والسرعة والسطوع. المعاينة تُحدّث هنا؛ هذه التغييرات remain فقط في هذا Tab.
tour.status.title: حالة الخدمة
tour.status.text: يُظهر whether خدمة الخلفية قيد التشغيل ومدى smoothness عرضها.
tour.status.demo: البيانات الوهمية تعني أجهزة وهمية. قراءات المستشعرات وقيم الأداء illustrative، not measurements.
tour.done.title: أنت جاهز
tour.done.text: ضع أجهزتك under Layout حتى تتماشى التأثيرات مع مكتبك. يمكنك بدء هذه الجولة في أي وقت في Settings.
contact.intro: تواصل مع فريق freeRGB أو تابع المشروع على YouTube.

cooling.channelBindings.nameAPhysicalHea: Name a physical header and assign its RPM sensor. These annotations do not verify wiring, change electrical mode or authorize hardware control.
cooling.channelBindings.theDaemonIsRunni: The daemon is running without persistent storage.
cooling.compositeCurvesSection.buildCurv: Build curves from other curves: constant values, two-threshold triggers, mixes and followers. Outputs are a live preview only and are not yet applied to any fan. A missing, stale or critical sensor shows 100 % and passes that through every mix, so a minimum can never hide a failure.
cooling.compositeCurvesSection.failSafeM: Fail-safe: missing, stale or critical input
cooling.coolingSetup.everyHeaderWithAnRp: Every header with an RPM sensor needs a role (fan or pump) before anything is slowed down. Go back to Identify and assign:
cooling.coolingSetup.freergbFoundTheseFa: freeRGB found these fan-controller chips through the motherboard service. Each header has a support tier that decides how far it may be slowed down.
cooling.coolingSetup.fanControlIsLockedU: Fan control is locked until the safety notice is accepted. Detection works; the tests below stay disabled.
cooling.coolingSetup.calibrationMeasures: Calibration measures each confirmed fan at 100 → 80 → 60 → 40 % (never lower) and stores its RPM range, so RPM targets and avoided ranges work. The fan returns to the BIOS afterwards. Windows asks for permission.
cooling.coolingSetup.noHeaderIsConfirmed: No header is confirmed as a fan yet. Go back and identify one, or skip.
cooling.coolingSetup.aStartingCurvePerCo: A starting curve per confirmed fan, following its chip temperature: quiet at idle, 100 % from 78 °C, full speed on a sensor fault. Pumps and unconfirmed headers are left alone. You can fine-tune every curve on the Cooling page afterwards.
cooling.coolingSetup.alreadyHasACurveUnc: · already has a curve (unchecked keeps it)
cooling.coolingSetup.noConfirmedFanWithR: No confirmed fan with RPM and temperature sensors; nothing to propose.
cooling.coolingSetup.setupFinishedYourFa: Setup finished. Your fans are listed below; change curves, limits and avoided ranges there at any time.
cooling.coolingView.yourFansWhatControls: Your fans, what controls them, and the curves they follow.
cooling.coolingView.advancedUnrestricted: Advanced: unrestricted control, header labels, temperature sources, custom sensors, composite curves
cooling.curvesSection.aCurveWithThisName: A curve with this name exists.
cooling.curvesSection.arrowKeysAdjustShi: % · arrow keys adjust, Shift for bigger steps
cooling.curvesSection.advancedMinimumCri: Advanced: minimum, critical, hysteresis, step limits
cooling.curvesSection.thisIsTheDefaultCu: This is the default curve. Change it and save it under a name, or pick a saved curve.
cooling.fanCard.spinItUpFor8SecondsAt: Spin it up for 8 seconds at 100 % to see which fan it is. Nothing is ever slowed down for this.
cooling.fanCard.runTheChannelTestFirstTo: Run the channel test first to allow lower speeds.
cooling.fanModel.notIdentifiedYetFreergb: Not identified yet — freeRGB leaves it to the BIOS
cooling.fanOverview.fanControlIsLockedUn: Fan control is locked until you accept the safety notice. freeRGB only shows the readings.
cooling.fanOverview.applyingYourFanSetti: Applying your fan settings — confirm the Windows prompt.
cooling.fanOverview.noControllableMother: No controllable motherboard fan headers were found.
cooling.fanOverview.motherboardFanContro: Motherboard fan control is not installed. Run freeRGB Setup again to add it.
cooling.fanOverview.changesAreSavedInThe: Changes are saved in the protected service and keep running from Windows startup, also with this window closed. Windows asks for permission when you apply.
cooling.hwmonSection.usesTheKernelSMothe: Uses the kernel's motherboard sensor drivers (nct6775, it87, nct6683, f71882fg, …). Fans keep a
cooling.hwmonSection.minimumUnlessUnrest: % minimum unless unrestricted control allows fan stop; missing temperatures drive 100%.
cooling.hwmonSection.fanControlIsPausedA: Fan control is paused; all headers follow the BIOS.
cooling.hwmonSection.noFanHeadersFoundLo: No fan headers found. Load your board's sensor driver, e.g.
cooling.liveSession.stopAllAndReturnToBi: Stop all and return to BIOS
cooling.liveSession.runCurvesOrFixedSpee: Run curves or fixed speeds on several fans at once. Select the physical fan and its matching RPM and temperature. Windows authorization is requested when a channel starts. Closing this window leaves the daemon and its fan sessions running; remembered channels resume after a restart while their hardware is unchanged.
cooling.liveSession.freergbWillControlTh: freeRGB will control this fan directly. Safety limits stay active: pumps at 100 %, fans never below their tier floor, any sensor or worker fault returns the fan to the BIOS. You are asked once per session.
cooling.liveSession.liveControlIsUnavail: Live control is unavailable. Enable the optional motherboard provider through the installer and restart the daemon.
cooling.liveSession.theTestRuns1007050Ne: . The test runs 100 → 70 → 50 % (never below 40 %) and returns the fan to firmware control; a new BIOS or board invalidates it.
cooling.liveSession.lhmSupportedChannels: LHM-supported channels run reduced-speed curves only after a passed channel test; calibration (100 → 40 %) is available.
cooling.liveSession.thisHeaderIsAssigned: This header is assigned as a pump; live tests are for fans only.
cooling.liveSession.identifyThisHeaderAs: Identify this header as a fan on its card above first.
cooling.liveSession.liveCurvesRequireAMi: Live curves require a minimum of 40% and a critical temperature at most 100°C. Channel selection alone does not establish a physical header or PWM/DC mode.
cooling.liveSession.findStallAndStartSpe: Find stall and start speed (unrestricted fans only; the fan stops briefly)
cooling.liveSession.outputShapingCurveFi: Output shaping (curve, fixed duty, composite and RPM modes)
cooling.liveSession.appliedAfterTheCurve: Applied after the curve, before the safety floor. Sensor faults and critical temperatures still go straight to 100 %. Fan stop only on unrestricted fans, never on pumps; RPM ranges use this fan's measured speeds.
cooling.liveSession.measuredValueValueRp: Measured {p0}–{p1} RPM. The target starts from the duty of that measurement; closed loop then corrects it from the live RPM (open loop again while the RPM reading is missing). Faster targets run at 100 %, slower ones are refused.
cooling.liveSession.runTheChannelTestOrC: Run the channel test or calibration on this fan first; RPM targets use its measured speeds.
cooling.liveSession.theDaemonEvaluatesTh: The daemon evaluates the composite curve and feeds its duty to this channel. If the daemon stops, a sensor fails or the selected temperature reaches 80 °C, the fan goes to 100 % or back to the BIOS.
cooling.pluginModel.pluginStoppedNoDevic: Plugin stopped; no device fail-safe needed (virtual).
cooling.pluginModel.failSafeSentValueVal: Fail-safe sent: {p0}/{p1} reports written by freeRGB.
cooling.pluginsSection.pluginsAreSignedP: Plugins are signed packages that run as separate processes. freeRGB owns the device, allows only the reports the signed policy lists, and applies the same floor, pump, lease and fail-safe rules as built-in fans.
cooling.pluginsSection.fixedDutyOrACompo: Fixed duty or a composite curve. Pumps stay at 100%; a stale reading, an expired lease or a plugin fault returns the channel to 100% and then to its firmware control.
cooling.sensorsSection.combineRealTemper: Combine real temperature readings into new sources — corrected, combined or averaged. The service evaluates saved sources even while this window is closed. Missing or stale inputs make a source unavailable instead of guessing.
cooling.sensorsSection.noConnectedDevice: No connected device currently reports a temperature.
cooling.shapingModel.fanStopNeedsAnUnres: Fan stop needs an unrestricted fan channel.
cooling.shapingModel.spinUpIsAtMost100Fo: Spin-up is at most 100 % for 10 s.
cooling.sourceModel.networkPathsAreDisab: Network paths are disabled by default
cooling.sourcesSection.everySourceBelowC: Every source below can drive a custom source, a composite curve or a fan. Stale or invalid readings count as missing, and fans then run at 100%.
cooling.sourcesSection.noTemperatureSour: No temperature source is reporting yet.
cooling.sourcesSection.readsTheFirstNumb: Reads the first number from a local file (max 4 KiB) every second. Files not updated for 10 s, outside −20…150 °C or unreadable count as missing. Scale, bounds and timeout are editable in the API.
cooling.sourcesSection.name: name
cooling.sourcesSection.fixedDutyOrACompo: Fixed duty or a composite curve. Fans keep their floor; missing curve output drives 100%. Release, pause, exit or any write error returns the fan to the driver's automatic mode.
cooling.sourcesSection.fanControlIsPause: Fan control is paused; GPU fans follow the driver.
cooling.support.everyWriteIsCheckedByRea: Every write is checked by reading the chip's registers back.
cooling.support.librehardwaremonitorCanD: LibreHardwareMonitor can drive this header; freeRGB checks the fan's RPM response instead of the registers. Reduced speeds need a passed channel test.
cooling.support.unlockedByYouForUntested: Unlocked by you for untested hardware: down to 0 % (fan stop), deviations are only warnings.
cooling.support.noUsableFanControlOnThis: No usable fan control on this channel.
cooling.support.theProtectedServiceDidNo: The protected service did not report support for this channel.
cooling.support.anotherProgramAlreadyCon: Another program already controls this header (software mode); freeRGB will not take it over.
cooling.support.heldAt100AfterAWorkerCra: Held at 100 % after a worker crash. Restart Windows to return it to firmware control.
cooling.supportBadge.coveragePerFanContr: Coverage per fan-controller chip (FAN_COVERAGE.md). Simulated only means no hardware acceptance for this chip yet.
cooling.unrestrictedSection.forHardwareF: For hardware freeRGB has not tested. An unlocked channel needs no channel test, may run down to 0 % (fan stop) and only warns about implausible RPM; a wrong LibreHardwareMonitor mapping can address the wrong header. Still always active: return to firmware on stop, crash, lost telemetry and watchdog expiry, 100 % at critical temperature, no takeover of a header another program controls.
cooling.unrestrictedSection.allowUnrestr: Allow unrestricted control (off by default; turning it off disables every unlock and re-validates background channels)
cooling.unrestrictedSection.theProtected: The protected service reports no board identity; unlocks are unavailable until it is updated.
cooling.unrestrictedSection.typeTheChann: Type the channel name "{p0}" to confirm
cooling.unrestrictedSection.iUnderstandT: I understand the risks for this channel.
cooling.unrestrictedSection.unlocksAreBo: Unlocks are bound to this board, its BIOS version and the channel; any change invalidates them. Pump confirmation is only accepted for channels bound as pump.
cooling.fan.firmware: The motherboard firmware controls this {role}. freeRGB only watches it.
cooling.fan.belowFloor: This curve goes below {floor} %, the lowest speed allowed for this {role}.
mainboardRgb.mainboardRgb.noSupportedMot: No supported motherboard RGB controller was found (ASUS Aura USB, Gigabyte RGB Fusion 2 USB, ASRock Polychrome USB).
mainboardRgb.mainboardRgb.fansChainedPer: Fans chained per header for presets
mainboardRgb.mainboardRgb.notAValidFreer: Not a valid freeRGB motherboard RGB file
mainboardRgb.mainboardRgb.headersWith0Le: Headers with 0 LEDs keep their firmware effect. Lighting returns to the firmware effect when freeRGB stops.
mainboardRgb.vendorRunning: {names} is running and controls the motherboard lighting. freeRGB leaves the motherboard alone until it is closed.
devices.title: Devices
devices.summaryNone: Everything freeRGB found, with live status.
devices.empty.title: No devices found
devices.empty.text: freeRGB only talks to devices it supports. Check the connection, close other RGB software, or start the service with a virtual demo device.
layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Where each device sits on the effect canvas. Effects are painted onto this canvas and every device shows its part.
layout.empty.title: No devices to place
layout.empty.text: Devices appear here as soon as the service finds them.
layout.help: Drag to move, drag the corner to resize. Snaps to the 5 % grid when you let go — hold Alt for free placement. The tinted background only suggests the current effect.
lighting.title: Lighting
lighting.custom.empty: Adjust an effect and use “Save as custom effect” in the settings panel to keep it here.
lighting.custom.name: Custom effect name
lighting.note.audioPulse: Reacts to the sound your PC plays. Audio capture runs only while this effect is active.
lighting.note.audioSpectrum: Eight frequency bands across the canvas, bass on the left.
lighting.note.screen: Mirrors the primary monitor. Place devices in Layout to match where they sit around the screen.
lighting.layer.note: Upper layers are drawn over lower ones.
macros.deviceKeysPanel.bindingsSavedActi: Bindings saved; activation requires an explicit session opt-in.
macros.deviceKeysPanel.assignMappedF6F10: Assign mapped F6–F10 keys. Typing keys, modifiers and cancellation F11 are reserved.
macros.deviceKeysPanel.physicalSourceIde: Physical source identity awaits owner verification. Anonymous keyboard events never trigger these bindings.
macros.deviceKeysPanel.enableDeviceMacro: Enable device macro keys for this session
macros.recordingPanel.reviewTheDraftThen: Review the draft, then save it explicitly.
macros.recordingPanel.recordingEndedTheU: Recording ended; the unsaved buffer was discarded.
macros.recordingPanel.recordingUnsavedFo: ● Recording — unsaved, focused pad only (30 s maximum)
macros.recordingPanel.recordIntoThePadNo: Record into the pad. Nothing is saved until you save the macro.
macros.recordingPanel.recordTextAsOneSte: Record text as one step when stopped
macros.recordingPanel.typeKeysHereFocusC: Type keys here. Focus changes discard recording. Use Stop or F12 to review.
macros.shortcutsPanel.globalMacroShortcu: Global macro shortcuts are configured and registered in freeRGB Classic. Keep Classic running while using them.
macros.shortcutsPanel.shortcutsSetHereAr: Shortcuts set here are not saved or registered. Global shortcuts still work through freeRGB Classic for macros; opening programs needs a decision on how the service may start applications.
macros.stepEditor.textToTypeIntoTheFocus: Text to type into the focused app
market.title: Effect Marketplace
market.sort.name: Name A–Z
market.err.package: Your installed effects remain available. Check the connection or retry the operation.
market.err.runtime: Select another effect in Lighting, or reapply settings to retry.
market.err.ratings: Previously loaded scores may be out of date.
market.report.title: Review error report
market.report.intro1: Includes the error code, app/effect versions, operating system and reduced device information. Device names, serial numbers, paths, sensor readings and rating credentials are excluded.
market.report.intro2: You can edit or remove information before sharing. GitHub issues are public; submitting there requires a GitHub account. No report is sent automatically.
market.report.tooLong: Shorten the report or copy it into GitHub manually.
market.report.opened: GitHub opened. Review and submit the issue there. freeRGB has not sent the report.
market.report.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select and copy the report text below.
monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Live service status and sensor readings.
monitoring.noSensors: No connected device reports sensor values.
monitoring.diag.text: Saves an offline report for bug reports. It leaves out device IDs and serial numbers, paths, names, raw error texts and your macro and profile contents. Nothing is uploaded.
monitoring.diag.fanHint: Adds board model, BIOS version, fan chip, support tier and channel-test result per control (no serials or readings).
monitoring.classicNote: Sensor history graphs and warning rules still run in freeRGB Classic; they move here in M5.
onboarding.safety.intro: Controlling fans and pumps is safety-relevant. Please read every point.
onboarding.safety.langNote: The safety notice is shown in English only, so the accepted wording is exactly the same for everyone.
onboarding.safety.sureText: freeRGB will be allowed to change fan and pump speeds on this PC. You can withdraw this at any time in Settings → Setup.
onboarding.safety.without: Without this confirmation freeRGB never changes fan or pump speeds. Lighting works either way.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to freeRGB
onboarding.welcome.text: A few minutes to get everything running: a safety notice for fan control, then freeRGB looks for your lighting devices and installs what they need, and finally you identify your motherboard fans. Lighting and fans run in a background service, so they keep working when this window is closed.
onboarding.welcome.safetyText: Read and accept the fan-control safety notice. Lighting works without it.
onboarding.welcome.devicesText: Detected lighting devices get their verified extensions automatically.
onboarding.welcome.fansText: Identify each motherboard fan header and mark pumps safely.
onboarding.accepted.title: Safety notice accepted
onboarding.accepted.text: You accepted the current safety notice earlier. You can withdraw it at any time in Settings; fan control then locks again.
onboarding.skipSafety: Skip — set up lighting only (fan control stays locked)
onboarding.fans.title: Motherboard fans
onboarding.summary.title: You're set
onboarding.summary.fansText: {fan} confirmed · {pump} pumps (kept at 100 %) · {none} not assigned · {blocked} not testable
onboarding.summary.fansLocked: Fan control locked — safety notice not accepted
onboarding.summary.serviceText: Lighting and fan control keep running when this window is closed.
onboarding.summary.safetyText: Accept it later in Settings → Setup to enable fan control.
onboarding.summary.note: Fan curves, background control and profiles are under Cooling. You can run this setup again from Settings.
profileview.title: Profiles
profileview.description: Snapshots of your effect and brightness. Load one to switch instantly.
profileview.off.title: Profiles are turned off
profileview.off.text: The service was started with --no-state, so nothing can be saved. Restart it without that option to use profiles.
profileview.name: Profile name
profileview.modifiedHint: Loaded last, but the lighting has changed since — click to restore
profileview.autoText: Application profiles (switch when a program comes to the foreground) still run in freeRGB Classic. They move here once that logic is shared between both apps (M5).
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.label: Display language
settings.language.hint: Applies immediately. “Automatic” follows your system language.
settings.plugins.none: No plugins are configured. Plugins are enabled when the service starts (--plugin); see docs/PLUGIN_SYSTEM.md.
settings.plugins.notAllowed: Not allowed by the service configuration
settings.classic.text: Open Classic for application profiles, global shortcuts, sensor history, warning rules and updates. Both interfaces use the same background service.
settings.classic.unavailable: Classic is unavailable in browser preview
settings.help.text: A short walk through the most important parts of freeRGB.
settings.about.classicText: freeRGB Classic stays available for low-resource PCs; both apps control the same service and share all settings.
settings.setup.again: Run the setup again: safety notice, device detection and extension downloads, motherboard fan identification.
settings.setup.accepted: Fan-control safety notice accepted. Withdrawing it locks all fan and pump control again (lighting is unaffected).
settings.setup.locked: Fan control is locked until the safety notice is accepted in the setup wizard.
settings.updates.unavailable: Updates are available in the desktop app
settings.updates.hint: Check GitHub for a newer stable freeRGB release. Downloads are verified (SHA-256) before Setup starts.
settings.kbd.title: Keyboard reactions
settings.kbd.intro: Pressed keys glow over the current lighting and fade back. Capture listens to physical keys on all local keyboards; only selected RGB keyboards react. Typed text and input history are not saved.
settings.inbox.title: Your messages
settings.contact.title: Contact the developers
settings.contact.intro: Send feedback or an optional hardware report to the freeRGB team. Only admins can read submissions. Nothing is sent until you review and confirm it.
settings.contact.placeholder: What would you like to tell us?
settings.contact.desktopOnly: Sending reports is available in the desktop app.
settings.contact.reviewText: This is the exact content that will be sent. You can remove details before sending.
settings.contact.reviewHardwareNote: Hardware reports omit device names, serial numbers, paths and raw errors.
settings.contact.errEmpty: Please enter a message before sending.
settings.contact.errObject: The report must be a JSON object.
settings.contact.errSize: The report must be smaller than 30 KB.
settings.contact.sentMessage: Your message was sent to the freeRGB developers.
settings.contact.sentHardware: Your hardware report was sent to the freeRGB developers.
setup.err.offline: freeRGB could not reach the module source. Check the internet connection, then try again.
setup.err.source: The module source is not available.
setup.err.permission: freeRGB is not allowed to open this device.
setup.err.busy: Another program is using this device. Close other RGB software and try again.
setup.err.invalid_package: The downloaded module failed verification and was not installed.
setup.err.incompatible: No compatible module exists for this system yet.
setup.err.initialization: The device did not accept the module's setup.
setup.err.timeout: The device did not respond in time.
setup.err.removed: The device was disconnected during setup.
setup.card.cannot: freeRGB cannot control this device yet.
setup.panel.running: Your other devices keep running while these are set up.
setup.extras.note: Modules never update on their own. Source: {source}{unavailable}.
setup.wizard.testSim: This simulates a two-second light test. No physical device will light up.
setup.wizard.testReal: The chosen devices glow once in soft white for about two seconds, without flashing, and then return to the lighting freeRGB is showing now.
setup.wizard.title: Set up your devices
setup.wizard.introSelect: freeRGB looked for lighting devices. Supported ones are selected; freeRGB downloads only the modules they need.
setup.wizard.introSim: Simulated setup — keep this tab open. Nothing is downloaded or installed.
setup.wizard.introWorking: You can close this window — setup continues in the background service.
setup.wizard.introDone: Everything that could be set up is ready. You can change devices later under Devices.
setup.wizard.catalog: The module catalog is unavailable, so new devices cannot be set up right now. Installed modules keep working offline.
setup.wizard.none: No lighting devices that need setup were found.
setup.wizard.retryLater: Failed devices can be retried here or later under Devices.
validation.pointDuty: Point duty must be between the minimum and 100 %.
validation.monotonicCurve: Temperatures must increase and duty must not decrease.
validation.curveCriticalLimit: The curve extends beyond the critical temperature.
validation.chordKey: Add exactly one key: a–z, 0–9, enter, escape, tab, space, backspace or an arrow.
validation.delay: a delay must be a whole number from 0 to 10 s.
validation.totalDelay: All delays together (times repeat) must stay within 60 s.
validation.triggerDuty: idle duty must not exceed load duty.
validation.linearBounds: needs min < max ≤ critical temperature and min ≤ max duty.
validation.equilibriumDuty: min duty must not exceed max duty.
validation.curveCycle: Curves must not refer to each other in a loop.
onboarding.fanStep.testOneHeaderAtATimeF: Test one header at a time. freeRGB holds it at 100 % for {seconds} seconds — it never slows anything down here — then hands it back to the motherboard. Listen and watch which fan or pump speeds up, then tell freeRGB what it was. Windows asks for permission for each test.
onboarding.fanStep.giveTheHeaderANameFor: Give the header a name, for example CPU_FAN or Front intake.
onboarding.fanStep.noControllableMotherb: No controllable motherboard fan headers were found. Fan control may be unavailable on this board, or the motherboard components were not installed. Run Setup again to retry.
onboarding.fanStep.nameOfThisHeaderAsPri: Name of this header (as printed on the board or where the fan sits)
onboarding.fanStep.noClearSpeedupSeenPic: (no clear speed-up seen; pick it manually)
onboarding.fanStep.pumpsAndHeadersYouDid: Pumps and headers you did not confirm are never slowed down. The channel test runs only on confirmed normal fans, never below 50 %, and returns the fan to firmware control afterwards.
onboarding.fanStep.theModeEndedStateTheH: The {mode} ended: {state}. The header was returned to firmware control.
onboarding.fanStep.theMotherboardService: The motherboard service is not ready ({status}): {message}
